| # Summary of steps {#summary-of-steps-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                     |                                                                                                                                         |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Here is the summary of the steps to be followed for ASW development using CODESYS, that are described in previous chapters

 

+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Step                                   | Artefact name                                                        | Where to find                                                                                                                                       | How often                                             |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Install CODESYS                        | RC5-6: CODESYS V3.5.21.40 32 bit                                     | CODESYS Store                                                                                                                                       | For every RC release/ until notice from Bosch Rexroth |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        | RC18-12 & RC27-18:  CODESYS V3.5.21.40 32 bit                        | [-CODESYS v3.5.21.40](https://store-archive.codesys.com/ftp_download/3S/CODESYS/300000/3.5.21.40/CODESYS%203.5.21.40.exe){.weblink target="_blank"} |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| replace Gateway.cfg                    | Gateway.cfg                                                          | myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/GatewayCFG                                                                                                       | For every new Workflow                                |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Install library to repository          | BODAS-bsw.library                                                    | BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/                                                                                                                           | For every new Workflow                                |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Install device to repository           | BoschRexroth_RC40-small_devicedesc.xml                               | BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/                                                                                                                           | For every new Workflow                                |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Install additional plug-ins            | Bodas Files Generation.package, CODESYS Safety SIL2 3.5.21.0.package | BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/AdditionalPlugins.zip                                                                                                      | For every new Workflow                                |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Import easyConfig xml files to project | bds_rts_ec.xml                                                       | BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/easyConfig                                                                                                                 | For every change in easyConfig                        |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        | GvlLinCanSignals.xml                                                 |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        |                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
|                                        | GvlDsmDfc.xml                                                        |                                                                                                                                                     |                                                       |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Hex generation & flashing              | \<project_name\>\_merge.hex                                          | CODESYS project directory                                                                                                                           | For every build of ASW                                |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
